principle: Evidence is collected by an owner-controlled read-only workflow; executor-supplied identity, permission or approval fields are never authoritative.
activation_prerequisites: Owner-controlled bootstrap PR installs the collector on the protected default branch; this proposal cannot activate itself.
Replace every placeholder with principals and installation identifiers independently observed from APIs.
Create an owner-controlled executor registry plus provider-signed or equivalent external attestation binding principal, installation and session to a role.
Prove effective GitHub App permissions exhaustively; unavailable, unknown or incomplete permission evidence fails closed.
Prove protected branch review rules and protected production environment settings through readable API evidence.
Separate PR author, technical auditor and owner approver principals; no self-approval.
Keep session-guard v1 active until v2 passes adversarial tests and the owner separately approves migration.

owner_authorization.merge: A distinct owner login must submit APPROVED on the exact current head SHA; author cannot approve own PR.
owner_authorization.deploy: A distinct owner approves a protected production environment; self-review disabled and protected branch required.
owner_authorization.technical_audit: ChatGPT PASS is advisory evidence, never GitHub authorization.

current_limitations: Current writes appear under a shared owner-linked identity, so provider identity is not authenticated.
A GitHub App login or session declaration alone does not prove the model or runtime that operated it.
This proposal and its CI are untrusted PR code and cannot collect production authorization evidence.
The policy must fail closed until all activation prerequisites are independently observable.
